prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Summon Gesture", "Try double-clicking your companion icon to quickly hide or summon it on your screen."]
1: ["Preparing desktop engine and rendering pet graphics in the background."]
2: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "Select whether to create a custom companion from photos or adopt a pre-designed pet friend."]
3: ["Signing in links your pet safely to your cloud account so your companion is never lost."]
4: ["Adjust Custom Pet Photo Alignment", "Center your pet's face inside the preview frame for optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Confirm Framing"]
5: ["Finding Your Pet on Your Desktop", "Your companion stays active in your system tray. Right-click the tray icon to bring your pet to the front or minimize it.", "System tray icon controls pet visibility anytime", "Got It!"]
6: ["Adoption Certificate Registered!", "Your pet certificate is officially registered. Next, your desktop companion will finish rendering on your screen."]
7: ["Rendering continues safely in the background if minimized. Your pet will appear on your desktop shortly."]
8: ["Includes Free Starter Accessory"]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your companion is live on your desktop screen. Click below to begin your first interaction."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or promotional offers
